globalBoundaries: Use this as a format-reference profile, not as a promise to recreate the PDF exactly.
Do not infer source body content, proprietary wording, image content, or exact coordinates from the evidence pack.
Do not claim high-fidelity export, visual restoration, or exact editable template reconstruction.
Where evidence is missing, use conservative GB/T 9704-2012-like defaults only as fallback defaults and mark them as low confidence.
Preserve structural intent and formatting constraints over pixel-level visual matching.
rationale: Evidence supports a PDF-derived reference profile with 15 pages, limited text operators, many images, font-resource hints, and low scan risk; detailed editable formatting must remain conservative and GB/T-like rather than exact.

attributes.name: pageBox
attributes.value: unknown-from-evidence; prefer GB/T-like A4 portrait fallback only when target output requires a page box

attributes.name: layoutZone
attributes.value: page-scoped layout zones; exact margins not recoverable

attributes.name: marginSignal
attributes.value: insufficient coordinate evidence; do not infer exact margins

rules.detail: Formatting engines should preserve page-aware pagination checkpoints and avoid expanding the adapted draft far beyond the observed reference length unless source content requires it.
rules.rule: Treat the document as a page-based reference with a fixed 15-page observed extent.

attributes.name: imageDensity
attributes.value: 108 images / 15 pages = about 7.2 image resources per page

attributes.name: layoutZone
attributes.value: separate text, figure, and table zones where content requires mixed media

rules.detail: The combination of 15 pages and 108 images indicates a finished, visually dense reference; adapted output should prefer compact, disciplined spacing and clear section breaks over loose prose-only layouts.
rules.rule: Use moderate-to-high page complexity assumptions when placing adapted content.

attributes.name: textLayer
attributes.value: present-or-hinted

attributes.name: readingOrder
attributes.value: semantic-source-first; PDF text-operator order is advisory only

rules.detail: Because text operators are limited relative to page count and image count, headings, captions, and lists should be reconstructed from draft semantics rather than copied from PDF operator order alone.
rules.rule: Treat text extraction as present but sparse; infer hierarchy cautiously.

attributes.name: readingOrder
attributes.value: body text follows logical document order supplied by the draft

attributes.name: layoutZone
attributes.value: main text zone should remain distinct from image-heavy regions

rules.detail: For adapted prose, use consistent paragraph indentation, controlled line spacing, and heading separation; do not derive exact line breaks from the reference PDF.
rules.rule: Use GB/T-like paragraph discipline when editable text must be generated.

attributes.name: imageDensity

attributes.name: layoutZone
attributes.value: figure/table/media regions should be explicitly bounded from prose regions

rules.detail: When adapting a draft, keep placeholders or figure slots only where the draft has corresponding visual content; do not invent or reposition missing source images from the PDF reference.
rules.rule: Use image count as a complexity signal, not as an instruction to fabricate images.

attributes.name: fontRef
attributes.value: MicrosoftYaHei-Bold, SegoeUI-Bold, MicrosoftYaHei, SimSun, SegoeUI resource hints

attributes.name: fontSizePt
attributes.value: not recoverable from evidence

rules.detail: Use Chinese office-document compatible fonts for generated editable text; embedded subset names and PDF resource names must not be treated as guaranteed installed fonts.
rules.rule: Treat PDF font resource names as diagnostic font references only.

attributes.name: fontRef
attributes.value: role-based mapping: heading-bold, body-regular, fallback-Chinese-compatible

rules.detail: For GB/T-like output, map headings to bold Chinese-compatible sans or serif styles and body text to readable Chinese body fonts; maintain internal consistency instead of matching resource names exactly.
rules.rule: Use role-based typography rather than exact PDF font matching.

attributes.name: scanRisk

attributes.name: textLayer
attributes.value: usable as advisory evidence

rules.detail: The reference is not flagged as likely scanned, so text and font clues may inform layout rules at medium confidence while exact visual recovery remains out of scope.
rules.rule: Low scan risk permits cautious formatting inference, but not pixel reconstruction.

rules.detail: Adaptation should record conflicts between the draft and the reference profile, then prefer draft semantics where structure differs from the reference.
rules.rule: Use the PDF as a finished-reference constraint set, not as an editable source template.

attributes.name: tableSignature

rules.detail: The evidence pack reports no table inventory; generated tables should follow GB/T-like clean borders, aligned headers, and compact spacing only when required by the draft.
rules.rule: Do not infer table grids unless the draft supplies tabular content.

rules.detail: Because no reliable section list was extracted, numbering should be generated from the target draft outline using GB/T-like hierarchy conventions rather than copied from the PDF reference.
rules.rule: Use explicit hierarchical numbering only when the draft structure requires it.
